data.desc: James Hardie Building Products, Inc. is part of the James Hardie group of companies that offer premium exterior and outdoor living solutions through industry-leading brands, including Hardie siding and trim, TimberTech decking and railing, AZEK trim and moulding, and StruXure pergolas. Together, these brands represent The Home of Resilient Beauty, helping homeowners and building professionals create beautiful, resilient, low-maintenance home exteriors and outdoor living spaces. James Hardie Building Products, Inc. is a wholly owned subsidiary of James Hardie Industries PLC (NYSE / ASX: JHX).
